summary: Make image attachment admission byte-budget-driven across all clients and preserve the Desktop composer until the backend accepts one atomic turn.

storageDataMigration.reason: Image arrays and outbox attachments keep their existing stored shapes; the change removes a count admission rule without changing schemas or migrations.

updateRelease.reason: No package identity, signing configuration, updater contract, versioning rule, or release channel changes.

hardware: Side-by-side Android debug APK installed on CPH2487; instrumentation rendered six dummy image attachments, kept the draft and aggregate-budget error visible, and kept the attachment control enabled.
notExercised: Desktop drag/paste with more than four real screenshots was not smoke-tested in the running Electron app.
React Native/iOS picker behavior was not exercised on an iOS device.
Native Android's external document picker and a live backend image turn were not exercised; the on-device test used six deterministic dummy attachments.
